Corollary
[Bochner vanishing]

↗ lem:function-bochner-formula ↗ def:hessian-norm-sq ↗ def:ricci-curvature

Suppose $\Delta f$ and $| abla f|^2$ are constant and $\Ric (( abla f)^*,( abla f)^*)(p)\ge 0$. Then $\Hess (f)_p=0$. Hence a harmonic function of constant gradient norm on a manifold with non-negative Ricci curvature has parallel gradient.
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:function-bochner-formula ↗ def:hessian-norm-sq

The derivative terms in Bochner’s formula vanish, leaving a sum of the two non-negative quantities $|\Hess (f)|^2(p)$ and $\Ric (( abla f)^*,( abla f)^*)(p)$. Thus the Hessian vanishes, and $\Hess (f)(X,Y)=\langle abla _X( abla f)^*,Y angle $ makes the gradient parallel.

□
